{{Top}}
[[File:LaserCutterU9-C4.png|thumb|right|250px|A laser cutter used by U9-C4 during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
{{Quote|EXTREME CAUTION -- Do not look directly into laser beam.|A hazard label on [[U9-C4/Legends|U9-C4's]] laser cutter|<ref name="Secret Weapons">{{TCW|Secret Weapons}}</ref>}}
A '''laser cutter''', also known as a '''cutting laser''', was a type of [[Laser/Legends|laser]] used for cutting. A cutting laser was contained within the finger of the right arm of the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] line of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] created by [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]].

[[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] were advertised as having laser cutters as standard equipment at no extra cost.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> [[Inferno firefighting robo]]s were equipped with laser cutters to cut through doors and flaming wreckage. [[GRZ-6B wrecker droid]]s had a laser cutter built into its right palm.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
